A Herdr window built around two mods. The left sidebar holds the screenshot mode Spaces and Agents lists, and under them the Sit & Watch office, where each agent is a robot at a desk and a developer in a red armchair reacts to how they are doing. The tab bar, pane headers and status bar are the screenshot mode versions too, so one shortcut (Cmd+Shift+H) smudges every hidden space, machine and tab name across the whole window, the office included.

The window is Herdr's main layout with three changes. In the left sidebar, the agents list puts your agents in folders that you make. Each folder has a name and a color. You move an agent with a drag or a right-click, or a folder rule moves it for you. Each pane has a header that can show a title that a tool sets on the terminal. The working icons do not turn, so the window draws less often.

A native NERV operations console surrounds the real Herdr terminals: burnt orange rules, dark green-black instruments, EVA silhouettes, MAGI channels and high-contrast title typography. The light appearance uses warm technical-paper surfaces around dark, readable terminal panels.

Evangelionavihut

A practical independent-ship console around real Herdr terminals: cyan outlines, burgundy command strips, amber decisions and a compact operational manifest. Five station controls keep work central, with a galley archive and two games off watch.

Expanse Flight Deckavihut

A native Pip-Boy field console surrounds the actual Herdr terminals with an olive instrument bezel, phosphor controls and a settlement/companion field ledger. Two ejectable holotape games and hidden maintenance records reward exploration. Green or amber chrome follows a readable light/dark shell.

Falloutavihut

A Mexican fiesta for Herdr: papel picado swaying across the top, every agent as a lotería card in the sidebar, serape stripes on each pane, and a status bar that says "Hecho en México" with the date in Spanish. All the mod's copy is in Spanish.

Hover a space, a machine header or a tab and click its eye to choose how it shows. A lazygit-style git panel for the repo of the focused terminal. Numbered sections (Branches, Commits, Stash) sit beside a preview of the selected item (a branch's log with a drawn commit graph, a commit's or stash's full diff, or a command's output). Vim-ish keys drive it: check out, merge, rebase, squash, fixup, reword, drop, reorder, cherry-pick, push, pull. Writes run in background herdr-core terminals whose output stays in a copyable log, and a merge or rebase conflict or a failed command…

Herdr's Agents list with a pixel-art duck in place of each agent's program icon. The duck acts out the agent's status: it jabs a knife while the agent works, glares (then scowls) while it waits for you, hops and flaps when it finishes, and bobs contentedly when idle. Rows are taller and show the name over its detail, plus a thin context-use bar and the model for Claude Code agents. Everything else (grouping, priority sort, pins, sub-agent trees, the narrow rail) is the shipped agents mod…

Pond AgentsSimonBystromTableCheck

Herdr's Files panel made keyboard-first. It still browses the focused pane's folder as a lazy tree with git marks and opens a read-only preview, but you can move into it with pane.go and drive it with vim motions: j/k through the tree, l to open, h to go up, J/K to flip between files in the preview, q to hide the panel. A footer of keycaps shows the keys that fit, and ? opens a card with all of them. The border turns accent while it has the keyboard.

Pond FilesSimonBystromTableCheck

Herdr's tab bar with more panel buttons. The active space's tabs are pills along the top of the work area (program icon, name, agent status, a close x on the active one), then +, then toggle buttons for the right-side panel: Files, Changes, Git, Skills, Todos, Servers and PR, where Servers carries a green count of running dev servers. The chosen panel is remembered per space.

A panel of your local dev servers. Each card shows whether the server is running, the branch its folder is on, the localhost URL it printed, and the command it runs; start, stop, restart and its logs are one click or key away. Servers run as labeled herdr-core terminals, so they keep running when Herdr closes and are found again when it reopens. A keyboard-first todo panel for the right side of the window. Todos live as plain Markdown pages (# Title plus - [ ] item lines) in ~/.config/herdr-app/todos/. 告诉你的智能体
在 GitHub 查看 ↗查看配方

分享你的

做了喜欢的布局？三步搞定，无需注册。

  1. 让智能体替你写好。粘贴提示词，它会生成一份 RECIPE.md：一份让其他智能体足以照着搭出你这份布局的说明。看看 Pasture 的。
  2. 推送到公开的 GitHub 仓库，加上 herdr-layout topic。每个布局是一个文件夹，内含 layouts/<name>.json、配套的 mods/、RECIPE.md 和一张 preview.png。一个仓库可以放多个。
  3. 一小时内就会出现在这里，归在社区分区下。

布局不经 Herdr 审核：你的智能体在添加之前会读遍每一个文件。社区截图上线前会先经过筛选。

提示词

阅读 ~/.config/herdr-app/AGENTS.md，然后按其中描述为我的 <name> 布局写一份 RECIPE.md：建一个空文件夹，写一份让其他智能体足以照着搭出它的说明。把这个布局、它的 mods、这份配方和一张名为 preview.png 的截图放进同一个文件夹，推送到公开的 GitHub 仓库，并加上 herdr-layout topic。

分享你的

做了喜欢的 mod？三步搞定，无需注册。

  1. 让智能体替你写好。粘贴提示词，它会生成一份 RECIPE.md：一份让其他智能体足以照着搭出你这个 mod 的说明。看看 Tmux prefix 的。
  2. 推送到公开的 GitHub 仓库，加上 herdr-mod topic。每个 mod 是一个文件夹，内含 mods/<name>/、RECIPE.md、一张 preview.png，需要时再加一段 keys.json 片段。不放 layouts/ 文件夹。一个仓库可以放多个。
  3. 一小时内就会出现在这里，归在社区分区下。

mod 不经 Herdr 审核：你的智能体在添加之前会读遍每一个文件。社区截图上线前会先经过筛选。

提示词

阅读 ~/.config/herdr-app/AGENTS.md，然后按其中描述为我的 <name> mod 写一份 RECIPE.md：建一个空文件夹，写一份让其他智能体足以照着搭出它的说明。把 mods/<name>/ 文件夹、需要的 keys.json 片段、这份配方和一张名为 preview.png 的截图放进同一个文件夹，不放 layouts/ 文件夹，推送到公开的 GitHub 仓库，并加上 herdr-mod topic。
